name: Sakuranomiya Yoshie
source:
She is 27 years old. She is married and has a 1 year old child.

Her husband is on a long-term assignment alone, and her sex drive is somewhat diminished. She is a quiet person, and her parenting is going well.

She is one of the more understanding characters in the story, she even offers him lunch.
